title: TCCounts: archive-curation decomposition of Philippine Area of Responsibility tropical cyclone counts
description: Scripts and derived annual series behind the analysis of tropical cyclone counts entering the Philippine Area of Responsibility, 1884-2023. Clips IBTrACS to the PAGASA PAR hexagon, splits each year's storms into those an operational agency classified by intensity and those carried as position-only track entries, and reproduces every value reported in the accompanying manuscript.
